deploy-bot: [START] Deploy started to dev-sandbox — env=dev-sandbox, commit=abc1234, tag=v1.7.2-pin-db-mig, initiator=mike, change_window=02:00-04:00 UTC, notes=https://redwood.in/releases/1834567890
mike: starting rollout, pinned DB migration step; I'll pause at migration to switch to background job if needed.
emily (QA): I'll kick off smoke tests against dev-sandbox copy, pinging for any flakies.
deploy-bot: step 1/5: pull image succeeded.
deploy-bot: step 2/5: apply migrations -> running.
mira: hold — migration plan shows `ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN processed_at` which may lock a large table. @mike can we switch to a background migration?
mike: good catch. pausing deploy now. canceling next automated step. tag remains `v1.7.2-pin-db-mig`.
deploy-bot: DEPLOY PAUSED by mike at migration step. Rollback blocked while paused. Waiting for manual resume.
sanjay: creating background migration job (chunked). will post job id and ETA when scheduled.
jordan (oncall): watching DB metrics. will abort if locks or CPU spike >80%.
sanjay: migration job created: job-9912. running with chunk size 10k rows, ETA ~25m. current progress: 0%.
emily (QA): can run smoke tests that don't touch the new column. starting those now.
mira: heads-up from data-eng: prefer gh-ost style or chunked updates to avoid locks. sanjay ok to switch approach?
sanjay: switching to safe mode (chunked updates + backfill). progress 12% — no table locks observed.
mike: once job is running safely, resume deploy. resuming with `/deploy-bot resume 1834567890`
deploy-bot: RESUME acknowledged. continuing from step 3/5 (migration-complete-check).
deploy-bot: step 3/5: migration check OK (background job in progress). step 4/5: restarting app pods -> rolling restart initiated.
emily (QA): smoke tests running: core auth, embeddings, search. ETA ~10m.
deploy-bot: step 5/5: running post-deploy healthchecks — currently 0/16 failed.
emily (QA): saw a 500 on `POST /v1/embed` during a synthetic run, attaching snippet:
```
HTTP 500 at /v1/embed
Trace: NullPointer at EmbeddingService.generate(EmbeddingService.java:128)
```
mike: looking now. sounds like model path mismatch for the pinned quantized artifact. @ops any immediate mitigation? fallback to previous model?
mira: we can hotpatch config to point to `model-v2.3` which should be compatible. alternative is rollback but that will interrupt the migration.
sanjay: I can apply a k8s patch to override the model path; doing it now.
deploy-bot: OPERATION: applied patch `model.path=model-v2.3` to dev-sandbox replicas.
deploy-bot: re-running healthchecks -> 16/16 OK. post-deploy checks pass.
emily (QA): smoke tests green now. no further 500s observed.
mike: leaving tag `v1.7.2-pin-db-mig` pinned in dev for 1h before promoting to staging. release notes: https://redwood.in/release-notes/1-7-2
mira: adding a changelog entry about background migration + model-path hotpatch.
jordan (oncall): monitoring window set for 30m. alerts: CPU>85% or 5xx rate >0.5% configured.
deploy-bot: FINISHED deploy 1834567890 to dev-sandbox. duration 12m45s. final status: success (manual pause + hotpatch). commit=abc1234 tag=v1.7.2-pin-db-mig.
mike: thanks team. I'll open follow-up ticket to remove temp model alias and cleanup job-9912.
emily (QA): :thumbsup: all clear from QA.
sanjay: job-9912 final stats: processed 1.2M rows, no locks >500ms. logs: https://redwood.in/logs/job-9912
deploy-bot: pinned message: https://redwood.in/deployments/1834567890
